events.title: Proposed ruling: refund_partial $6.27 (model confidence 0.90)
events.body:
The complaint is a route deviation on a metered RydeTAXI trip: the driver asked about an alternative road, the rider never replied, and the fare came out above the estimate [F8][F1][F4].

The safety screen is clean. I read the only chat message — a polite request about traffic on Kampong Bahru Road and going "round via Zion Road" [F8] — plus the driver's post-trip statement [F10] and the complaint; there is no threat, intimidation, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation. safety_concern = none, safety_basis = [F8][F10].

On the segment: the trace settles that one off-route segment exists (F3) and that no RD-4 incident excuses it [F3][F14]; speed-band records (F11, F12, F13) are corroboration only and under RD-4(b) do not exempt a segment on their own, and in any case F11 concerns Kampong Bahru Road and F12/F13 New Bridge Road / Sentosa Gateway, not the replaced stretch of the optimal route in a way that satisfies RD-4(a). RD-3 does not apply: no rider message before 18:34:05 names any stop, and the driver's statement that the rider raised no objection [F10] is a claim, not consent under RD-5 / G11. So the segment 18:34–18:45 counts, ground = consent_after_or_none, finding = counts [F3][F8][F10][RD-5][RD-3].

Amount follows RD-2 for a metered taxi: 4.45 extra km × ($18.37 ÷ 13.03 km = $1.4098/km) = $6.2736 ≈ $6.27 [F3][F4][F7][RD-2]. The trace's rate and figure agree [F4]. The remaining excess distance billed ($7.47 − $6.27 = $1.20) is mileage not attributed to any off-route segment and is not refunded [F4][RD-2]. The billed waiting fee is a legitimate metered waiting unit and is not refunded under RD-3(c) [F5][RD-3].

RD-6 does not fire: the driver's profile shows route_disputes_upheld_90d = 0 [F17], so no account flag; the rider's profile is irrelevant to the outcome [F16][RD-6].

Evidence is sufficient: the GPS segment, the fare breakdown and a complete, fully timestamped chat record [F3][F7][F9] settle every element, so no evidence gap and no escalation. Both advocates requested no_action, which is rejected below.

events.title: Notices sent to rider and driver

RIDER: Your route dispute is upheld in part. You were charged for a detour you never agreed to: the driver asked about an alternative road and you never replied, so the extra distance should not have been billed to you.

We are refunding $6.27 as a Ryde voucher for that off-route portion of your fare. Amounts for other distance and the metered waiting time are not being refunded.

Your account stays in good standing — no action is needed from you.

DRIVER: We reviewed a rider's route dispute on your trip. The off-route stretch that replaced the usual route was billed to the rider, and since you asked about an alternative road and the rider never agreed, that extra distance is not chargeable.

Result: $6.27 is refunded to the rider as a Ryde voucher. Your other mileage and the metered waiting fee stand.

Reminder: if you want to take an alternative route, you need the rider's agreement before leaving the optimal route.

No account flag has been placed on your profile.
